rules: Only inferred-original rows are eligible for the main LOEO evaluation.
The external experiment is untouched until final prediction for that outer fold.
Standardization, PCA, UMAP fitting, feature selection, resampling, hyperparameter tuning and probability calibration are fit on development data only.
If SMOTE is evaluated, it is applied only inside inner-training data; never before an outer or inner split.
Test 5 streams 1 and 2 remain grouped together as one external experiment.
Per-experiment Macro-F1 is computed on target-supported classes; pooled LOEO Macro-F1 across all out-of-experiment predictions is computed on the fixed label set 1-5.
No model is selected from outer-test performance.
